First, I need to calculate the scheduled monthly payment for a 60-month loan at 6% annual interest (0.5% monthly rate) on $20,000 principal.

Using the loan payment formula:
P = PMT × [1 - (1 + r)^-n] / r

Where:
- P = $20,000 (loan principal)
- r = 0.005 (monthly interest rate)
- n = 60 months

Rearranging to solve for PMT:
PMT = P × r / [1 - (1 + r)^-n]

PMT = 20,000 × 0.005 / [1 - (1.005)^-60]
PMT = 100 / [1 - (1.005)^-60]
PMT = 100 / [1 - 0.74137]
PMT = 100 / 0.25863
PMT = $386.66
